message: Astra: Within Alice's email, does “Detailed Steps and Considerations” make her more distinctive, or could another manager send the same instructions? What in your actual revision supports your judgment? When you return to the meeting dialogue, what unfinished work on the email still deserves attention? Why would more thinking about her voice be worth the time compared with attempting a revision now, and what uncertainty would make thinking first more useful? Which next step will you choose and carry out, and what change on the page would tell you it helped?
